title: lathyrus canescens proles bauhini
intro: Lathyrus canescens proles bauhini, commonly known as Lathyrus, is a plant species in the legume family. It is often referred to as a wild pea or a grass pea. The plant is rich in health benefits, including being a good source of protein, fiber, and minerals. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus include isoleucine, leucine, and other essential amino acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and its therapeutic actions may also include diuretic and antispasmodic effects.
